display_long_description:
The Innisfree Garden Tour turns the legendary landscaped grounds of Rhinebeck, New York into an immersive escape you can explore using natural hand interactions and teleport-style map navigation.

Built for presence, crafted for calm, the experience combines ultra-high-resolution 360° stereoscopic capture with spatial sound design, bringing every bend of the path, pond reflection, and drifting cloud into view.

What you’ll experience
• Stunning 360° video optimized for clarity on Meta Quest
• Spatial environmental audio that shifts dynamically as you explore—birds, breeze, and lake ambience surround you in 3D space
• Teleport across iconic locations using interactive spatial map pins
• Toggle between seasons to see Innisfree transform through Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter
• Curated pacing & design perfect for first-time VR users

This experience is carefully designed to bridge the gap between cinematic immersion, mindfulness, and XR.

Ideal for
Nature lovers • Mindfulness sessions • Spatial tech explorers • Landscape architects • Audio-driven storytellers

Take a moment. Look around. Let nature unfold.
